info.title: Bulk Live Weather API Reference
info.description: Retrieve real-time weather conditions for multiple locations in a single POST request, up to 50 locations per batch. Each location can be specified as a city name or address, GPS coordinates, or IP address. The response contains a bulk array with one entry per requested location in the same order; each entry includes the same location and current weather objects as the single Live Weather endpoint, including full air quality (AQI indices and pollutants) and astronomical data (sunrise/sunset, moon phase, day length). A location that can't be resolved (missing fields, unrecognized address) doesn't fail the whole request — that slot gets a small `{"error": "..."}` object instead of a full result, even when every item in the batch fails. The optional timezone query parameter sets a default timezone for all results. A malformed request body, or a non-object item in the locations array, fails the whole request with a 400.

post.summary: Get real-time weather data for multiple locations, coordinates, or IP addresses
post.description: Retrieve current weather conditions for up to `50 locations` in a single request. A maximum of 50 locations (city names, IP addresses, or geographic coordinates) can be included in the request body.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Override timezone for all returned data. Defaults to each location's local timezone.

partialFailure.summary: Batch with an unresolvable location — that slot gets an error object, request still succeeds

400.description: Bad Request — Missing/malformed request body, or a non-object item in the locations array

value.message: Please provide data in required format in request body

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

locations.description: Array of location objects to query. Maximum 50 items per request.

BulkCurrentRequest.description: Request body for bulk live weather lookup, containing an array of location specifications.

BulkLocationItem.description: Each object specifies one location using exactly one of the supported lookup methods: location alone, lat+long together, or ip alone. None of these fields is required at the schema level — an item missing all of them is still accepted by the request, but resolves to a per-item error object in the response (see BulkCurrentResponse) rather than failing the whole request.

location.description: City name, place name, or full address

oneOf.description: A successfully resolved location's weather result.
Returned in place of a weather result when that location could not be resolved (missing fields, unrecognized address, etc). Does not fail the request, even when every item in the batch errors.

bulk.description: Array of per-location results, one entry per requested location, in the same order as the request. Each entry is either a full weather result or a per-item error object.

BulkCurrentResponse.description: Bulk weather response containing an array of per-location current weather results.

CurrentWeatherResponse.description: Current weather response containing location data and current weather conditions.

BulkWeatherItemError.description: Per-item error, returned in place of a weather result when an individual location could not be resolved.

error.description: Human-readable reason this location could not be resolved (e.g. "Location not found", "Missing required location parameters").

WeatherLocation.description: Location information. The shape of this object varies by lookup method.

oneOf.description: Location data when the target is specified by GPS coordinates (lat/long).
Location data when the target is inferred from an IP address.
Location data when the target is specified by a city name or address string.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -90 (South Pole) to +90 (North Pole). Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -180 (West) to +180 (East). Returned as a string, not a number.

country_name.description: Full name of the country corresponding to the provided coordinates.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division name for the location.

city.description: City or municipal area name associated with the coordinate location.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, district, or village name within the broader area.

elevation.description: Height above mean sea level in meters for the specified coordinates. Returned as a string, not a number; can be an empty string when unavailable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Abbreviated timezone representation based on current offset (e.g., EST, GMT, PST).

LocationByCoordinates.description: Location data when the target is specified by GPS coordinates (lat/long).

continent_code.description: Two-letter continent code (e.g., NA for North America, EU for Europe, AS for Asia).

continent_name.description: Full name of the continent where the IP address is registered.

country_code2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code (e.g., US, GB, FR).

country_code3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA).

country_name.description: Common name of the country associated with the IP address.

country_name_official.description: Official long-form country name as recognized internationally (e.g., United States of America).

is_eu.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country is a member state of the European Union.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division associated with the IP location.

state_code.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for the state or province (e.g., CA for California).

district.description: District, county, or secondary administrative division within the region.

city.description: City or urban area name where the IP address is geographically registered.

zipcode.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the approximate location of the IP address.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for the IP geolocation, ranging from -90 to +90. Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for the IP geolocation, ranging from -180 to +180. Returned as a string, not a number.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, or small area designation within the city.

elevation.description: Elevation above mean sea level in meters for the IP geolocation. Returned as a string, not a number; can be an empty string when unavailable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the IP location (e.g., America/Chicago, Asia/Tokyo).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Current timezone abbreviation based on local offset (e.g., CST, JST, UTC).

LocationByIP.description: Location data when the target is inferred from an IP address.

location_string.description: Original location query string as submitted, including full address or place name.

country_name.description: Resolved country name derived from the geocoded location query.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division identified from the location.

city.description: City or municipal area name extracted from the geocoded location.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, suburb, or village within the geocoded area.

latitude.description: Geocoded latitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -90 to +90. Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geocoded longitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -180 to +180. Returned as a string, not a number.

elevation.description: Elevation above mean sea level in meters at the geocoded coordinates. Returned as a string, not a number; can be an empty string when unavailable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the geocoded location (e.g., America/Los_Angeles).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Current timezone abbreviation for the location based on local offset (e.g., PDT, CET).

LocationByAddress.description: Location data when the target is specified by a city name or address string.

timestamp.description: Local timestamp of the current weather observation, in `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` format — not full ISO 8601 (no seconds, no timezone offset/`Z`).

temperature_2m.description: Current air temperature (°C) measured at 2 meters above ground.

relative_humidity_2m.description: Current relative humidity percentage at 2 meters above ground.

apparent_temperature.description: Current apparent temperature (°C) accounting for wind chill and humidity.

precipitation.description: Total precipitation (mm) including rain, showers, and snowfall.

weather_code.description: WMO weather condition code representing current conditions. Supported codes: 0 clear sky; 1, 2, 3 varying cloud cover; 45, 48 fog; 51, 53, 55 drizzle; 56, 57 freezing drizzle; 61, 63, 65 rain; 66, 67 freezing rain; 71, 73, 75 snowfall; 77 snow grains; 80, 81, 82 rain showers; 85, 86 snow showers; 95 thunderstorm; 96, 99 thunderstorm with hail.

cloud_cover.description: Current percentage of sky covered by clouds.

pressure_msl.description: Current atmospheric pressure (hPa) adjusted to mean sea level.

surface_pressure.description: Current atmospheric pressure (hPa) at surface level.

wind_speed_10m.description: Current wind speed (km/h) at 10 meters above ground.

wind_direction_10m.description: Current wind direction in degrees at 10 meters above ground.

wind_gusts_10m.description: Current wind gust speed (km/h) at 10 meters above ground.

astronomy.description: Astronomical information including sunrise, sunset, and moon phases for the current date.

air_quality.description: Air quality metrics including pollutant concentrations and AQI values.

CurrentWeather.description: Current weather conditions including temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind, pressure, astronomy, and air quality.

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format for the astronomical data.

mid_night.description: Time of true solar midnight in HH:MM format.

night_end.description: Time when astronomical twilight ends and dawn begins in HH:MM format.

sunrise.description: Time when the Sun becomes visible above the horizon in HH:MM format.

solar_noon.description: Time when the Sun reaches its highest point in the sky in HH:MM format.

sunset.description: Time when the Sun disappears below the horizon in HH:MM format.

night_begin.description: Time when astronomical twilight begins and night starts in HH:MM format.

day_length.description: Total duration of daylight in HH:MM format.

sun_status.description: Current position of the Sun relative to the horizon (above_horizon, below_horizon, or -).

moon_phase.description: Current lunar phase (NEW_MOON, WAXING_CRESCENT, FULL_MOON, WANING_GIBBOUS, etc.).

moonrise.description: Time when the Moon becomes visible above the horizon in HH:MM format.

moonset.description: Time when the Moon disappears below the horizon in HH:MM format.

moon_status.description: Current visibility status of the Moon (visible, not_visible, or -).

Astronomy.description: Astronomical data including sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, moon phase, and moon times.

timestamp.description: Local timestamp of the observation, in `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` format — not full ISO 8601 (no seconds, no timezone offset/`Z`).

european_aqi.description: Consolidated European Air Quality Index representing the highest value among individual pollutant indices. Ranges: 0-20 (good), 20-40 (fair), 40-60 (moderate), 60-80 (poor), 80-100 (very poor), >100 (extremely poor).

us_aqi.description: Consolidated U.S. Air Quality Index representing the highest value among individual pollutant indices. Ranges: 0-50 (good), 51-100 (moderate), 101-150 (unhealthy for sensitive groups), 151-200 (unhealthy), 201-300 (very unhealthy), 301-500 (hazardous).

pm10.description: Particulate matter with diameter less than 10 micrometers (μg/m³) measured at 10 meters above ground.

pm2_5.description: Particulate matter with diameter less than 2.5 micrometers (μg/m³) measured at 10 meters above ground.

carbon_monoxide.description: Atmospheric carbon monoxide gas concentration (μg/m³) at 10 meters above ground.

nitrogen_dioxide.description: Atmospheric nitrogen dioxide gas concentration (μg/m³) at 10 meters above ground.

sulphur_dioxide.description: Atmospheric sulphur dioxide gas concentration (μg/m³) at 10 meters above ground.

ozone.description: Atmospheric ozone gas concentration (μg/m³) at 10 meters above ground.

dust.description: Saharan dust particle concentration (μg/m³) at 10 meters above ground.

uv_index.description: Ultraviolet radiation intensity index accounting for cloud coverage.

aerosol_optical_depth.description: Aerosol optical depth at 550 nm wavelength indicating atmospheric haze levels.

uv_index_clear_sky.description: Ultraviolet radiation intensity index assuming cloud-free conditions.

AirQuality.description: Air quality metrics including European and US AQI indices plus individual pollutant concentrations.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
